name: Stage 50: Bälinge kyrka to Bråfalls såg
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 50, Bälinge kyrka to Bråfalls såg.
utilities: Bälinge kyrka is the practical start service point, with parking, nearby bus at Bällinge vägskäl, and user-reported church taps/toilet.

Bråfalls såg has parking, a picnic/rest shelter, heritage saw context, and a nearby Sörmlandstrafiken stop. OSM/secondary sources add toilet, bin, and fireplace context, but these are not all official stage-listed facilities.

The stage has no shop, cafe, or verified potable water between Bälinge and Bråfalls. Seasonal Bälinge Sommarkyrkan cafe and off-route lodging exist nearby only when open/booked; use Bälinge/Tystberga or plan onward to Nynäs services.
waterSources: Bälinge kyrka water/toilet reports are comment-sourced from the Stage 49 page rather than an official maintained Stage 50 facility listing. Treat them as useful but not guaranteed; verify season/access locally.
No reliable mid-stage drinking-water source was found. The small creek before the Bråfalls/50:1 split is natural water only and should be treated if used.
Bråfalls såg has toilet/rest access but no verified drinking-water tap.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 6 km; Naturkartan measures 5.7 km/5,735 m, AllTrails lists about 5.6 km, OSM relation 6567461 measures about 5.697 km despite a stale 7 km tag, and the local official-GPX-derived route is about 5.954 km with perfect internal snaps to stages 49, 51, and 50:1.

Stage 50 has source-coordinate alias clusters rather than separate trailheads: official start 58.843550,17.295850 is about 38 m from the local Stage 49/50 snap and about 21 m from the OSM Stage 49/50 snap; official Stage 51/Bråfalls start is about 13 m from the local Stage 50 end and about 4 m from the OSM Stage 50/51 snap.

The first roughly 3 km are on larger and smaller roads through open agricultural landscape; then the route enters Ramdalsskogen and the northern part of Nynäs nature reserve with hillier forest walking. Hiker reports describe the forest part as steep in places with rope assists and stable boardwalks near the stream.
At the signed split near the creek, the main route turns south/right to Bråfalls såg and Nynäs, while branch 50:1 continues toward Björken and stage 54.

Nynäs reserve rules matter here: overnighting in tent, hammock, wind shelter, caravan or camper is only allowed at designated places, fires/grilling only at prepared fireplaces managed by the reserve and only with provided wood, disposable grills are forbidden, and disturbing wildlife or damaging vegetation/dead wood is prohibited.

A 2025 official-page comment mentions poor marking toward Bälinge and rerouting connected to bark-beetle damage, but the official Stage 50 page itself shows no current fault report. Treat this as a navigation caution near the 50/50:1 area; the confirmed active bark-beetle reroute belongs to branch 50:1 and may not match stored GPX/OSM geometry.
Bråfalls is best treated as a rest shelter/picnic shelter, not a guaranteed overnight shelter. No designated Stage 50 campsite was verified.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka stage start
facilities.description: Official stage 50 start and stage 49 end at Bälinge kyrka.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka parking
facilities.description: Official/Naturkartan stage notes say parking is available at the start. Verify signs and church-event restrictions.

facilities.name: Bällinge vägskäl bus stop
facilities.description: Closest researched bus stop near the start, roughly 250-300 m away. Naturkartan references bus service near the stage start; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka water taps
facilities.description: Official stage 49 user comment from 2024 reports water taps outside Bälinge kyrka, but this was not found as an official maintained Stage 50 facility. Verify season/access before relying on it.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka toilet
facilities.description: Official stage 49 user comment from 2024 reports a toilet outside Bälinge kyrka, but this was not found as an official maintained Stage 50 facility. Verify opening/season locally.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka
facilities.description: Church with 1100s/medieval roots and a protected churchyard setting. Respect churchyard rules.

facilities.name: Bälinge churchyard rule
facilities.description: Treat the churchyard as a quiet memorial place: use paths/parking, avoid disturbing services/funerals, keep dogs controlled and away from graves, and do not picnic or camp on churchyard grounds.

facilities.name: Bälinge Sommarkyrkan seasonal cafe
facilities.description: Seasonal church cafe context with summer opening windows reported by the parish. Verify current-year dates and hours before relying on it.

facilities.name: Tegelkällan Bälinge hembygdsgård
facilities.description: Official Sörmlandsleden lodging list places Tegelkällan about 1.5 km from stage 50, with prebooking required. Approximate/off-route marker; not an on-route service.

facilities.name: Bälinge road-walk section
facilities.description: The first roughly 3 km follow larger and smaller roads in open landscape. Walk on the left side/shoulder where there is no footway, stay visible, and expect traffic exposure.

facilities.name: Stage 50 early asphalt traffic
facilities.description: A 2024 hiker report describes a short early asphalt section that can have traffic before quieter gravel-road walking. Use traffic care.

facilities.name: Grinda farm landscape
facilities.description: The route passes Grinda at a distance; official text notes the farm's old Carolinian-style building. Private landscape context only.

facilities.name: Ramdalsskogen / Nynäs reserve entry
facilities.description: The stage enters hillier forest and crosses into Nynäs nature reserve. Reserve rules override ordinary assumptions about camping, fire, plants and wildlife.

facilities.name: Stage 50 marking/navigation watch
facilities.description: A 2025 official-page user comment reports poor marking toward Bälinge and mentions a bark-beetle reroute, but no official Stage 50 fault report was found. Keep map/GPS handy; confirmed active bark-beetle reroute belongs to 50:1.

facilities.name: Bälingedalen viewpoint ridge
facilities.description: Approximate ridge/rest context where official text notes views over fertile Bälingedalen before a steep descent.

facilities.name: Ramdalsskogen steep rope-assisted parts
facilities.description: A 2024 hiker report describes very hilly/steep Ramdalsskogen passages with ropes tied to trees for support. Use care in wet, icy, or tired conditions.

facilities.name: Steep descent before Bråfalls
facilities.description: Official description notes a steep descent before the route returns to forest terrain. Use care in wet/icy conditions.

facilities.name: Creek before the route split
facilities.description: Small creek near the split before Bråfalls/50:1. Natural water only; treat/filter if used and avoid washing near the watercourse.

facilities.name: Stable boardwalks by stream
facilities.description: A 2024 hiker report describes stable boardwalks/spångar around the stream crossing area. Condition can change after storms or wet periods.

facilities.name: Stage 50 / 50:1 split
facilities.description: Signed junction at/near Frillingmossen: main route turns south/right toward Bråfalls såg and Nynäs; branch 50:1 continues toward sjön Björken and stage 54. Official fork is within about 5-7 m of local/OSM snaps.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg stage junction
facilities.description: Stage 50 end and stage 51 start at Bråfalls såg.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg
facilities.description: Historic saw building at the stage end, inside Nynäs reserve context. Secondary local history says a saw existed here by 1678 and operated into the 1940s. Look but do not disturb.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg rastskydd
facilities.description: Rest/picnic shelter at Bråfalls såg. OSM maps it as a picnic shelter; do not treat as a guaranteed overnight shelter.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg fireplace / spishus
facilities.description: Nynäs visitor material describes Bråfalls as a lunch stop by the fireplace and secondary source material describes a spishus/fire context. Nynäs reserve permits fires only at managed fireplaces with provided wood and current fire rules.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet near Bråfalls såg; official Stage 50 material does not separately list it. Verify season/current condition.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg bin caveat
facilities.description: OSM maps a bin at the Bråfalls shelter, but official shelter guidance often says not to expect bins. Pack out waste if unavailable or full.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg parking
facilities.description: Official/Naturkartan stage notes say parking is available at Bråfalls såg. Verify signs and do not block reserve access roads.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg bus stop
facilities.description: Mapped Sörmlandstrafiken stop east of the stage end, roughly 0.7 km by road/trail context. A second opposite-side stop is mapped nearby at 58.831965,17.365989. Verify live departures; official visitor pages more often emphasize Nynäs/line 554 access.

facilities.name: Nynäs reserve camping/fire rules
facilities.description: In Nynäs reserve, tent/hammock/camper overnighting is only allowed at designated places, generally max one night; fire/grill only at reserve-managed fireplaces with provided wood. Bråfalls rastskydd is not a designated campsite in the researched sources.

facilities.name: Nynäs bus access onward
facilities.description: Onward/off-route bus access by Nynäs, useful if continuing toward stage 51/Nynäs slott rather than ending exactly at Bråfalls. This is more than 2 km from Stage 50, so show as distant/off-stage access.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott distant services
facilities.description: Seasonal/off-stage services around Nynäs slott, including visitor information, food/contact services, toilets/RWC context, parking, and nearby STF Bränneriet lodging. More than 2 km from Stage 50; use only if continuing onto Stage 51/Nynäs.

facilities.name: STF Bränneriet distant lodging
facilities.description: Booked lodging near Nynäs slott/Stage 51-52, not a Stage 50 service. More than 2 km from Stage 50; useful only for onward itinerary planning.

facilities.name: Stage 50 fire-risk check
facilities.description: No fireplace was verified on the stage 50 core line. In Nynäs reserve, use only designated managed fireplaces and check current fire-ban status.
